output.summary: A flowering shrub native to the tropical Americas from extreme southern Mexico and Belize through much of Central America and northern South America, including many Caribbean islands. It grows upright on cane-like stems and has large green leaves, often patterned with white. Its sap is toxic, and ingesting any part may cause severe reactions or death.
output.edibilityNote: The entire plant contains calcium oxalate crystals; ingestion may cause anaphylactic shock, respiratory failure or death.
